_about: The table's measurements. Metres, Y up. The table runs along Z: break end at +Z, rack end at -Z. X 0, Z 0 is the centre of the playing surface and Y 0 is the top of the felt. The rules and the view both build the table from this file.

sizes._about: length and width of the playing surface, measured between the cushion noses

cushion._about: noseHeight: height of the cushion's contact edge above the felt. railTopHeight: height of the flat top of the rail. depth: from the cushion nose back to the wood. railWidth: width of the wooden rail behind the cushion; beyond its outer edge there is nothing and a ball falls to the floor.

pockets._about: mouth: gap between the two cushion nose tips of a pocket. jawRun: how far the angled jaw face runs toward the pocket's middle (along the rail) while it goes back by cushion.depth; given as plain numbers so no angle maths is needed. shelf: distance from the middle of the mouth line to the edge of the hole. holeRadius: radius of the hole a ball drops into.

spots._about: as a share of the table length from the centre. The line (head string) is at +lineZ * length; behind the line means Z greater than that. The front ball of the rack sits at -rackZ * length.
